game enhancement mod.name: Game Enhancement Mod
game enhancement mod.description: GEM by daemon_n adds interface improvements, optional gameplay features, scripts, plugins and binary patches. Optional features depend on GEM settings and the installed build. This reference belongs to this mod and is listed only while it is active.

categories.name: Interface and hints
categories.content: Hero-class appearances and town-level appearances improve map readability. Optional creature health bars and expanded creature previews add battle information. Resource counters support large values; mithril display needs sufficient screen width. Artifact hints can show primary-skill bonuses and combination parts. Adventure hints add map labels and route costs while Alt is held.

categories.name: Settings and optional gameplay
categories.content: Open GEM settings with its adventure-map button or the registered GEM entry in System Options. The town extra-functions menu uses the configured grave/tilde key by default. Optional quick-combat controls, spell research and additional town commands depend on settings. The author readme also documents grave/tilde on the adventure map; its binding can differ between builds. Use the settings button if it is unassigned.

categories.name: Gameplay plugin modules
categories.content: Gameplay_GameplayEnhancementPlugin.era supplies GEM interface hooks. Its module switches are graphics, features, resources, artifact_hints and adventure_hints under gem_plugin.modules. Restart after changing startup module switches. Resources and some interfaces require HD support. In-game feature options are separate from these startup switches.

categories.name: Army and artifact controls
categories.content: Hold A in town to preview upgrade cost, then click a supported troop or hero item to upgrade. Alt+W and Alt+D apply waiting or defence to the army for the round. Shift-click or middle-click an equipment slot to choose a compatible backpack artifact. GEM can override standard or HD controls in these places; consult the GEM Hotkeys section.

categories.name: Fixes and patches
categories.content: The included files cover guarded artifacts, pre-battle saves, battle replay, AI-versus-AI battle results, random-map descriptions, town upgrades, dwelling accumulation and map rendering. The generated Plugins section shows the actual files in this installation. Optional author descriptions attach only to matching files.

categories.name: Documentation sources
categories.content: Compiled from this mod's description_en.md, gem_script_text.json, gem_main.json, gem_settings.erm, gem_town_menu.erm, 79 wog - igrik.erm and Protection by all units in battle.erm, plus the gameplay and artifact-picker source code in this workspace. Help integration uses the separately installed ERA Help Dialog plugin. Keys mentioned only in older FAQ text are not assumed to be active in every build.
